term: logical consistency relative to mere ideas
definition: For the bounded source reading, absence of a refutation by reasoning from the ideas alone, expressed as ¬refutes(description). This is an interpretive interface, not a specified complete calculus and not a Lean consistency theorem about Hume’s reasoning.
note: Issue #248 analytical vocabulary, scoped to this test. A source endorsement would require a separate passage-specific claim; the existing I.3.3 claim supplies only the narrow reading.
